Stash 1.0.10

  • Frosted-glass window (new). Settings → Window background turns on a translucent macOS blur behind the app, with a slider to set how see-through it is. The blur follows your light/dark theme.
  • You can drag the window again. After the blended title bar, the top edge was swallowing clicks — dragging the window by the top strip works again, and double-clicking it zooms the window.
  • No more freeze when adding a project. Importing an FLP no longer freezes the window while it processes.
  • Creating a kit is more reliable. It no longer hangs when an external drive is offline — kits fall back to a local folder so creation always completes.
  • Right-click menus open at the cursor. Rename and confirm sub-menus now appear at the item you clicked instead of the row's far edge.
  • Kit view polish. The Kits sidebar shows a closed/open box for its toggle, and the detail panel's top row now fills to both edges (no gray gap on the right).
